name: agent-chat-session-to-notion

deploy.description: embeddable-agent-chat session.ended webhook -> fetch the full transcript via the Notion Agents Unofficial custom integration -> AI summary (standard/auto) -> log a record in the Agent Chat Sessions Notion database with the transcript as the page body.

trigger.trigger_note: Catch hook. The sender is the embeddable-agent-chat Lovable app (repo: work-flowers/internal/embeddable-agent-chat): its cron-driven dispatcher POSTs a `session.ended` event when a widget chat session ends (idle rollover or message cap), retrying failed deliveries up to 5 times with backoff. After first publish, paste the `webhook_url` readback into the widget's 'Webhook URL' field in that app's UI. The sender can HMAC-sign the body (X-Signature) when a secret is set; this workflow does not verify it — the payload carries only ids, and the transcript is re-fetched from Notion, so a forged POST can at worst create a junk log row.
trigger.payload_note: Payload shape: { event: 'session.ended', event_id, occurred_at, end_reason: 'idle'|'message_cap', widget: { id, name, agent_id, agent_name }, session: { notion_session_id, visitor_id, message_count, started_at, last_message_at, ended_at } }. Session id = session.notion_session_id; agent id = widget.agent_id. Metadata only — the transcript is fetched, never delivered.

connections_note: notion_agents is the 'custom-agent-embed' connection on the Notion Agents Unofficial custom integration (App245513CLIAPI@1.0.0, slug notion-agents-unofficial). notion_wf is the standard work.flowers Notion connection used by every Zap in this repo.

ai_model.why: Short-summary workload — exactly what Standard is recommended for. Verified on real session transcripts (see README table): summaries were accurate and followed the prompt's format rules at Standard; no capability gap suggesting a higher tier.

notion.note: Database created 2026-08-26; Dennis filed it under Marketing -> Databases the same day (data source since renamed 'Ask workFlowers Chat Sessions' in Notion; the id is what matters). Verified writable via notion_wf in the 2026-08-26 run-durable test.
